question.text: Trading hours for Domestic Agricultural Commodities (i.e., agri commodities other than agri-processed and internationally referenceable agri commodities) on Indian commodity exchanges are:

answer.text: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM
Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

explanation.text: The Logic: The source table prescribes 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday, for Domestic Agricultural Commodities. The 5:00 PM close aligns with physical mandi operating hours, keeping spot and derivatives prices connected during trading. The Trap: The broader "Agricultural Commodities (including agri-processed and internationally referenceable agri commodities)" segment trades 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, which made option C also source-plausible under the original broad stem. Non-agri commodities have extended hours up to 11:30 PM/11:55 PM (option B). There is no Saturday trading (option D). Note: Source: NISM-Series-XVI Commodity Derivatives Certification Examination, December 2025, p. 126. The stem has been narrowed to Domestic Agricultural Commodities to disambiguate from the 9 PM Agricultural Commodities (incl. agri-processed) segment also listed on p. 126.
